newsitem.title: FRANCE: Air France Europe cancels all Sunday flights.
newsitem.headline: Air France Europe cancels all Sunday flights.

text.p: Air France Europe, the regional arm of the Air France group, is cancelling all its Sunday flights after unions representing a majority of its pilots called a 24-hour strike, an airline spokeswoman said on Saturday.
" We are not in a position to assure any flights tomorrow. All the flights are cancelled," the spokeswoman told Reuters.
The airline advised passengers not to go to airports on Sunday but to contact its reservation centres for further information.

The strike was called by the USPNT, SPIT, SNPNAC and SNPL unions. "The chairman of Groupe Air France persists in his sole objective of breaking the social benefits in place at Air Inter," the former name of Air France Europe, the USPNT and SPIT said in a joint statement.
The Air France Europe spokeswoman said the unions represented more than half the pilots.

The unions at Air France Europe have been protesting against a plan announced last summer by Air France chairman Christian Blanc to merge Air France Europe into Air France, cut some routes, and bring its pilots' salaries in line with those at the international carrier which are around 15 percent lower.
